summary: Iteration 142 (WEB-only frontend). All three new Home enhancements verified end-to-end and no regressions observed. (1) PersonaNudge: renders at the top of every Home look (classic/ask/focus/start) for users with persona=null (verified for sam@funasia.net and os@radciti.com). All 5 chips (persona-pick-personal/student/team/business/enterprise) + persona-nudge-dismiss are present. Dismiss hides the nudge, persists to localStorage 'tn:tn:persona-nudge:dismissed'='1', and it stays hidden after reload. Picking 'team' fires PATCH /api/user/onboarding -> 200 and the nudge disappears immediately after refresh(). (2) Guided Highlights: opening the 'research' walkthrough on /dashboard renders data-testid=show-me-how-spotlight with the dim overlay + yellow ring around the real nav-research sidebar button; a coachmark card (with smh-prev disabled at step 0, smh-next advancing through 4 steps, and smh-goto on the last step) navigated correctly to /research. When the target selector (nav-ai-memory) is not in the DOM, the guide gracefully falls back to the centered modal (show-me-how-guide) without a spotlight. (3) Celebrate Completion: force-opening the checklist for sam (7/7) rendered checklist-celebration ('You're a TeamNest pro!') + a canvas-confetti burst + checklist-celebrate-done, which dismissed the card. After dismissal, localStorage 'tn:tn:checklist:celebrated'='1' was set and, without force, reloading did NOT re-celebrate. (4) Regression: nav-show-me-how -> show-me-how-menu still shows all 4 guides (smh-guide-research/meetings/memory/employees) + smh-open-checklist; incomplete checklist for os@radciti.com renders 3/7 progress bar, done items with line-through and no Go, incomplete items with checklist-go-*, and walkthrough-linked incomplete items (compared_models, hosted_meeting) additionally show checklist-show-*; IntelligenceBanner + home-look-btn present on all 4 Home looks. Backend not tested (per request).

issues: A promotional/onboarding tour popover ('Welcome to TeamNest… Show me') keeps appearing in the bottom-right on every page load for both sam and os. It never went away for the duration of testing and does not appear to be dismissible via an obvious CTA (only the small X). Consider persisting dismissal or excluding it from returning-user flows so it doesn't overlap the new PersonaNudge / Celebration UI.

action_items: OPTIONAL: audit the persistent 'Welcome to TeamNest' onboarding popover — it never dismisses across reloads for these two returning test users and visually overlaps the new PersonaNudge/Celebration in screenshots.

OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter141): allow PATCH /api/user/onboarding to accept {persona: null} so agents can reset users back to persona=null via API (currently 422, forces direct MongoDB touch to clean up).
critical_code_review_comments: PersonaNudge.jsx:22 uses safeStorage.get(DISMISS_KEY) which double-namespaces to 'tn:tn:persona-nudge:dismissed'. Consistent with the rest of the app but confusing when writing E2E tests — worth documenting or normalizing.

SetupChecklist.jsx:74 sets both React state (setCelebrated) AND localStorage inside the same useEffect that fires the confetti. Fine, but if a user hits the celebration inside a force-open, then reloads with force still '1' before dismissing, the guard (celebrated) will short-circuit and the confetti won't fire again — intended behavior per 'once, ever', worth noting.

ShowMeHow.jsx spotlight coachmark uses top: Math.min(Math.max(rect.top, 16), window.innerHeight - 340) with a hard 340px height — if the coachmark ever grows beyond 340px (long copy) it could clip off-screen. Consider measuring the actual coachmark height.

ShowMeHow.jsx:112 the dark backdrop <div onClick={close} /> is placed *behind* the coachmark, but the coachmark has no pointer-events guard on the outer container; a stray click on the ring/backdrop area outside the coachmark closes the whole guide silently. Acceptable, just note there's no explicit 'Close' affordance on the spotlight layer other than smh-prev/next/goto and clicking the backdrop.

Show Me How's Dialog now has an sr-only DialogTitle (per recent fix). Verified the Radix a11y console warning about missing DialogTitle is gone — but a new console warning remains: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}'. Consider adding an sr-only <DialogDescription> as well.
